skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic economic and social knowledge, apply it to solve real-world problems in the Real Estate sector.
Select and execute research on specialized topics using scientific methods.
Apply theoretical knowledge to practical situations in the Real Estate industry.
Analyze and solve problems using critical thinking skills.
Identify and solve problems in real-world scenarios.
Develop self-learning habits and improve professional skills independently.
Work effectively in teams and take responsibility for individual contributions.
Effectively present research findings and defend personal viewpoints.
Demonstrate ethical behavior and academic integrity in professional settings.
Plan and manage projects, including resource allocation and timeline management.
Understand relevant laws and regulations in the Real Estate sector.
Communicate effectively with peers, supervisors, and stakeholders.
